instructions_to_main_agent: Build the Travel Phrase Companion as a responsive web app. Install Outfit and DM Sans fonts.
Use Phosphor icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) for categories, audio buttons, and UI navigation.

The Hero section should be welcoming and visual. You can use the 'organic_background' image as an underlying subtle texture, and feature the 'hero_illustration' near the top or next to the main headline.

Create a 'Select Destination / Language' dropdown featuring the 14 specified languages: Japanese, Korean, Taiwanese, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Mandarin Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Cantonese, Tamil, Hindi, Sinhala, Urdu, Bengali.

Build a Category section using a Bento Grid or horizontally scrollable pill layout. Categories: Greetings, Shopping, Food/Dining, Directions/Navigation, Emergency, Social conversations, Transportation, Accommodation.
Include a Search input to quickly filter the currently displayed phrases.

Phrase Cards Design: Use the `phrase_card` style. The card must clearly show the English text and Native text. Include TWO distinct audio buttons: one for English, one for the Target Language. If possible, utilize the browser's native `window.speechSynthesis` API for actual audio playback. If not feasible for all languages, fallback to a mocked toast notification.

Color implementation: Heavily rely on the Organic & Earthy palette. Base background is #FAFAF8. Cards are #FFFFFF with #E5E1D8 borders. The primary action color is Terracotta #E07A5F. Avoid default tech blue.
Add `data-testid` to all interactive elements (dropdowns, category cards, play buttons, search input).
Ensure Header/Navbar uses a solid background (bg-[#FAFAF8]) or crystal glassmorphism if sticky, to prevent text collision when scrolling.
